question: The analysis of the data obtained from cases of Ebola virus disease in Guinea and Sierra Leone, allows us to affirm that:

options.opa: The mortality of the infection exceeds 85%.
options.opb: The treatment is based on support measures (hydroelectrolitic replenishment i.v. and antibiotics).
options.opc: More than half of the cases correspond to health personnel.
options.opd: Gastrointestinal hemorrhage is a common cause of mortality.

analysis: The analysis of Ebola virus disease cases in Guinea and Sierra Leone indicates that the treatment primarily involves supportive care, including intravenous fluid replenishment and antibiotics to manage secondary infections. The mortality rate of Ebola is high but typically does not exceed 85%. Health personnel are at risk, but they do not constitute more than half of the cases. Gastrointestinal hemorrhage is a significant symptom and can contribute to mortality. Mortality is generally higher in young children and older adults rather than adolescents.
